decks.notes: The main concept of this combo deck is to use cards like Axebane Guardian, Overgrown Battlement, Gatecreeper Vine, and Saruli Caretaker to generate a lot of mana quickly. The deck then aims to play Balustrade Spy to mill the entire deck into the graveyard, then use Dread Return to bring back Lotleth Giant or Troll of Khazad-dûm for a lethal finish. The deck also includes card draw and creature search spells like Land Grant and Lead the Stampede to help assemble the combo pieces quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards and generate mana to cast spells that allow you to return creatures from your graveyard to your hand, leading to a powerful combo finish. By utilizing cards like Songs of the Damned and Reaping the Graves, you can create a loop of casting and returning creatures to overwhelm your opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to help accelerate your mana production and get your combo pieces out as quickly as possible.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing the card Balustrade Spy to put your entire library into your graveyard. This allows you to trigger various graveyard-based abilities, such as reanimation with cards like Dread Return or generating massive mana with Songs of the Damned. The deck also contains cards that support this strategy, such as Exhume for graveyard recursion and Duress for disruption. By efficiently filling your graveyard and utilizing various combo pieces, you aim to overwhelm your opponent and secure victory in a Pauper 1 vs 1 matchup.

The main concept of this Orzhov Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher along with removal spells like Cast Down to control the board. The deck also includes card draw and lifegain options to help sustain the aggression and outvalue the opponent. The mana base consists of a mix of Swamps, Plains, and Orzhov dual lands to ensure consistent access to both colors of mana needed for the deck's spells.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to be able to quickly play creatures and deal direct damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast alongside efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Seeker of the Way, the deck aims to apply pressure early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Thraben Inspector and Journey to Nowhere also helps control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive plays and fast-paced combat to overwhelm the opponent.
